title: Invaders in Black
subtitle: That which obscures the sea, that which engulfs the clouds, comes heavily.

trails.title: Trail① Gold Prospector
trails.description: Speculators gather on the beach, trying to dig shiny objects from the sand. Those things don't belong to them.

items.text: Invaders in Black

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: Vertin, finally!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: The Manus suddenly emerged everywhere like ants! Lilya and I couldn't take them all down!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: I would have acted sooner if you hadn't told me not to pick fights!
A mad pawn roars and jumps on them but is immediately being pulled off and knocked out by Lilya.
His limbs twitch horribly, and his body soon shrivels.

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: D**n! All they want is to attack, even if their blood will be sucked out. Insane!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Back when we were spying on them, I told Sonetto to screw the peace agreement through the radio! I knew those geometry psychos and the Manus would go mad sooner or later!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: They were not that crazy when they were solving the math problems. D**n it!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: What the hell happened down there?!

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: The cave is the key to being immune to the "Storm."

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: There is a cave on this island which has the same effect as my suitcase. That's what the Manus are after!

items.speaker: Regulus
items.text: What?! But ...

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: But hasn't she also put on the stone bangle?

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: Even if she can break free from that bangle, there's no way she'd let her followers keep carrying out suicide attacks!

items.speaker: Lilya
items.text: And if she has signed that peace agreement, how will she take the cave from Apeiron?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Vertin.
On Vertin's back, 37 opens her eyes.
She puts out a finger and points it to the sky.
In the eternal and transcendental sky, several dazzling flare stars are lining up.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: What's that?
The Hall of Apeiron is in deadly silence.
Only a visitor is still browsing the classic book.

items.speaker: Six
items.text: I'm afraid you have overstayed your welcome, Ms. Arcana.

items.speaker: Six
items.text: I have to regrettably remind you not to overstep the boundaries, despite the great help you've given to us.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: I take not thought for needless disputes ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: But to ask a simple question.
She gently closes the book.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: The great philosophers ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: Ye seek the ancient wisdom, follow the sages' teaching, and pursue the noble virtues.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: You are separated from the world for thousands of years.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: And you have not gained the humans' understanding, nor have you sought for it.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: I find pleasure in this allegory of the cave.

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: However, hast this been unto thee ...

items.speaker: Arcana
items.text: ... That who led us to the exile in this cave?
The flare stars are approaching.
They move in an orderly manner, as if they are a group of swifts returning to their habitat.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: What are they? I've never seen these before.

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: Why are they here?

items.speaker: Thirty-seven
items.text: These things should not appear on this island.

items.speaker: Vertin
items.text: No! 37! NO!
The eternal and ever-circulating current has been cut off.
Upon the silent sea ...
A fleet in black is breaking the waves and sailing toward the island.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Sonetto.

items.speaker: Sophia
items.text: Did you bring the humans' army here?
THE END
